failureMessage: a declared standard with no scaffold silently enforces nothing — the isolation wall and the wiki discipline both hang off these fixed paths
fix: scaffold it per the template in packs/product-wiki/README.md, or remove the product-wiki declaration if this repo doesn't adopt the standard

requirePaths.what: the product-wiki standard requires {path} but it does not exist
the product-wiki standard requires {path} but it does not exist

failureMessage: the wikis are agent-rewritten, loosely-sourced research — code, tests and docs that silently depend on them inherit unreviewed churn
fix: depend on product-wiki/product-requirements (the one reviewed crossing point), remove the reference, or accept it with a reason in .claudinite-settings.json (rule "product-wiki-isolation")

forbidReferences.reason: the self-growing product wikis and their sample data are autonomous research the repo must not depend on; product-wiki/product-requirements is the one reviewed crossing point

failureMessage: the sections are the page's reader header plus the wiki's audit trail and backlog — without them compile-once/refine-in-place degrades to unsourced, unreviewable rewrites nobody can read at a glance

requirePresent.what: wiki page is missing its "## {section}" section
requirePresent.fix: add it — the reader header plus the growth machinery: citations, dated growth log, open-questions backlog (an empty "## Open questions" is valid)

failureMessage: a research page whose findings can only be recovered by reading it end to end does not get read — the header is what makes a compiled wiki usable to a human

requireFirstOnPage.what: the page opens with "## {first}", not its "## Key insights" header
requireFirstOnPage.fix: move "## Key insights" above every other section — a header a reader reaches after the body is not a header

forbidProseLines.what: prose in the Key insights header: "{line}"
forbidProseLines.fix: the header is a bulleted list only — make it a bullet or move it into the page body below the "## Key insights" section

maxBulletBlockLength.fix: cut it to the finding in plain words — the qualifiers, the supporting detail and the citation all live in the page body

minBullets.what: Key insights header carries no bullets
minBullets.fix: open the page with "## Key insights": 1–7 bullets, each one finding stated plainly in a line (max 140 characters)

maxBullets.what: Key insights header carries {bullets} bullets (max 7) — it has grown into a second body
maxBullets.fix: keep the 7 that matter most; the rest is what the page body is for

failureMessage: undated or absent log entries break the audit trail and the freshness signal every other growth mechanism keys on
fix: lead every growth-log bullet with the run date, e.g. "- **2026-07-15** — what changed"; append the seed entry when the page is first committed

whenUndated.what: growth-log entry does not lead with its date: "{bullet}"

whenNotRealDate.what: growth-log entry "{date}" is not a real calendar date

minBullets.what: growth log has no dated entries

failureMessage: a named source without its URL is an uncited citation — unverifiable by the next pass and by review

eachBulletBlockMatches.fix: every listed source carries its real URL (a markdown link or a bare URL); an honestly-unsourced page explains its status in prose instead of listing URL-less sources

failureMessage: a wiki that stopped growing silently stops being true — staleness must reach a human even when the unattended growth channel isn't firing

newestDatedBulletWithinDays.what: newest Growth log entry is {age} days old ({date}) — past the {days}-day freshness window
newestDatedBulletWithinDays.fix: run a growth pass (in-session: "grow the product wiki") or confirm the scheduler's wiki-growth task is wired; silence via rules: {"product-wiki-freshness": "off"}
